**Change:** ~ decision/parse-failures-surface-as-unknown · except: was «A hyprctl reply that fails its parse reads the closed error oversize or malformed with one parse-rejected line, never unknown.»; now «A hyprctl reply failing its parse reads oversize or malformed, and a StopFailure error word outside the CLI's set reads cause api-error, each with one parse-rejected line, never unknown.»
**Why:** decision/parse-failures-surface-as-unknown: An outside StopFailure error word now surfaces as the cause api-error with one parse-rejected unknown-value line, a second exception to the unknown value the rule names.
**Ref:** .andromeda/runs/2026-11-16T18-15-08-wrap/

- Unparseable external values become `"unknown"`, never an error, except a hyprctl reply the Hyprland seam cannot parse, which is the seam's `malformed` error, and a StopFailure error word outside the CLI's known words, which reads the turn-end cause `api-error`.

- `hook` module (as landed): `HookEvent` (10 registered events, `StopFailure` among them, the dialog tier `PreToolUse` / `PermissionRequest` included; `from_arg`, `kind()` — an `Option<EventKind>`, `None` for the dialog tier — `is_dialog()`, `as_str` = diag-line `$defs.hook_event`), `normalise(event, bytes) -> Normalised{kind, data, drift}` (StopFailure (`viola hook stop-failure`) maps to `turn-ended`, not a dialog, its data exactly `last_assistant_message` null, `background_tasks` null and `cause` one of the nine TurnEndCause words, classified from the CLI's error word inside the Claude adapter (a word outside the CLI's known words reads `api-error`); Stop's `turn-ended` data is `{last_assistant_message, background_tasks}`, with no `cause`: `background_tasks` the payload array's length only, no element read or carried, `null` when the key is absent, `null` or not an array). A wrong-typed known field → a drift entry `{path, expected:"string"}` and read as absent. Prompt order: classify `harness` on the RAW prefix, no trim (`HARNESS_PREFIXES`: `<agent-message from=` / `<task-notification>` / `<\cross-session-message` / `<cross-session-message` — the escaped cross-session form is the one escaped tag that classifies; as measured on 2.1.287 a real cross-session message arrived unescaped under `from` / `from-name` / `from-mode`, and a `<task-notification>` typed at a prompt's very start arrives as typed and is filed `harness`), then unwrap only the CLI's unescaped same-id pair `<pasted_content id="X">\n…\n</pasted_content id="X">` together with the frame the CLI writes around it (the two newlines directly before the open tag, the one directly after the close tag, and a second after it when text follows that is not the next pair's own two-newline frame; a third before, a second after at the prompt's end and a lone one before stay, an unmatched open tag removes nothing; one id serves every pair of a session), then un-escape `<\` before an ASCII letter or `/` — a typed pair is never unwrapped. A pasted text's last newline never reaches the hook (measured on 2.1.287, wrapped or not), so `text` lacks it. No `send` relies on this: `typed_text(text)` returns a sent text with every CR LF pair as one LF, every other CR as one LF, and without its trailing CR and LF characters, every one of them in any order (a `Cow<'_, str>`, borrowed unless an inner CR is replaced; it holds no CR, and nothing else changes: not a TAB, a space, or an LF that is not at the very end), and the root bin's `send` types and classifies that typed text and matches a `prompt-submitted` text equal to it, or non-empty and equal to it less its trailing run of ASCII space, TAB, CR and LF, the text kept as submitted; the client's `refusal_of` is its second product caller (the founder's rulings, 2026-10-07T15:21Z for a trailing LF, 2026-10-09 for a trailing CR and CRLF, 2026-10-09T16:51Z for a CR or a CR LF inside; architecture [Delivery Confirmation]). An LF typed inside a paste is submitted unchanged (as measured on 2.1.287 at chunk 2026-10-09-inner-cr-and-crlf-in-a-sent-text); every multi-line `send` relies on it, and it is gated by the ledger row `paste-newline` and its `viola verify` probe, Run B's `PROBE_NEWLINE_PASTE` (landed at chunk 2026-10-13-paste-newline-ledger-row, stamped on live 2.1.287 on the Linux dev host). The frame beside typed text and between two pairs is unit-held and unprobed (`viola verify` types only lone pastes), and no probe is owed: a shape no `send` relies on needs none (the founder's ruling, 2026-10-07). StopFailure is registered with no ledger row and no verify probe.

The shared vocabulary of every other crate: the normalised event kinds, `RefusalReason` and its closed detail sets (`HumanTyping { ManualPause }` among them), `TurnEndCause` (the closed cause set of `turn-ended`, nine words `rate-limited` · `overloaded` · `auth-failed` · `billing` · `invalid-request` · `model-not-found` · `server-error` · `output-limit` · `api-error`, no Claude-specific name), `UnreachableCause` (`StrictModes` · `InstanceDead` · `UnwrappedName` · `EndpointLost` · `ServerVerify` · `SocketDir`, each word through `as_str`, `SocketDir`'s `socket-dir-refused`: exit 21's closed cause set, with no serde path, the two clients writing every word, and no `RefusalReason`), the wheel's `WheelCause` (`start` · `human-input` · `manual-pause` · `release`), the nutype newtypes `ViolaName` and `DialogHold` (whole seconds 60–3600), the protocol `v` constants, the shared validators (`validate_paste_text`, and `is_code_word`: 1 to 64 bytes of `[a-z0-9-]`, a lower-case letter first), the `MAX_FRAME` constant (16 MiB), `SPINE_DEADLINE` (1 s, the spine bound the perf gate reads), `DIALOG_HOLD_DEFAULT` · `DIALOG_HOLD_MIN` · `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX` (60 s · 60 s · 3600 s: the dialog hold's default and bounds, `config.json`'s `dialog_hold_s` read once at the wrapper's start into a `DialogHold`; the hook bounds its reply read at `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX + 5 s`, below the `hooks.json` `timeout` of 3615), the injected `Clock` seam (`SystemClock` in production; first consumer `run`'s vt100 feed thread), `SERVICE_NAME` / `VERSION`, and the obs vocabulary (`obs_event!`, `ObsEvent`, `ObsProcess`). It performs no I/O and depends on no viola crate. It does NOT know Claude payload shapes (that is `viola-agent-claude`), and it does not depend on `tracing`: `obs_event!` expands to `::tracing::event!` at the caller.

- Normalised kinds live only in `viola-core`, never with Claude-specific names: `session-start`, `turn-ended` `{last_assistant_message, background_tasks, cause?}` (`cause` present only on an API-error turn end, one word of the closed nine-word `TurnEndCause` set: `rate-limited`, `overloaded`, `auth-failed`, `billing`, `invalid-request`, `model-not-found`, `server-error`, `output-limit`, `api-error`; absent on a Stop end), `prompt-submitted`, `question`, `permission`, `plan`, `session-end`, `activity`, `link`, `unlink`, `wheel`, `send-issued` `{cursor, from?}`, `send-confirmed` `{cursor, confirmed?}` (`confirmed:false` only for an unconfirmable send), `send-refused` `{refusal, detail, cursor?}` (the CL-1 send records, `source: wrapper`; `cursor` absent for a refusal before `send-issued`), `dialog-expired` `{dialog_id, dialog_kind}` (`source: wrapper`, appended once when a held dialog's hold ends; it carries no question, plan or tool text).

- SessionStart → `session-start` (`cause` startup|clear|resume|compact|unknown, `agent_session_id`; the hook may send an optional string `transcript` param beside `event`, never inside it, only when the transcript path passes the shape check against its own session id; the wrapper re-validates it for a session-start line only, drops any other, and it never enters event data); UserPromptSubmit → `prompt-submitted` (`text` normalised: long-paste wrapper removed, then tag escaping reversed; `origin` driver|human|harness — the hook files only human|harness, and `driver` comes only from the wrapper's relabel of the in-flight send's own prompt, matched on the send's typed text, the sent text with every CR LF pair and every other CR as one LF and without its trailing CR and LF characters, or on a non-empty text equal to that typed text less its trailing run of ASCII space, TAB, CR and LF, the text kept as submitted); PreToolUse AskUserQuestion → `question`; PreToolUse ExitPlanMode → `plan`; PermissionRequest → `permission` (a PermissionRequest repeating the armed `question` / `plan` dialog's tool with an equal `tool_input` is that dialog's continuation and raises no event); Stop → `turn-ended` (`last_assistant_message` or `null`; `background_tasks`, the Stop payload's `background_tasks` array length, a count only, or `null` when the key is absent, `null` or not an array); StopFailure (`viola hook stop-failure`) → `turn-ended`, not a dialog (data exactly `last_assistant_message` null, `background_tasks` null and `cause` one of the nine `TurnEndCause` words, classified from the CLI's error word inside the Claude adapter); SessionEnd → `session-end`; Notification / PostToolUse / PostToolUseFailure → `activity`.

- Timestamps via chrono `to_rfc3339_opts(SecondsFormat::Millis, true)`; malformed external values become `"unknown"`, never an error (except a hyprctl reply the Hyprland seam cannot parse, which is the seam's `malformed` error; a StopFailure error word outside the CLI's known words reads the turn-end cause `api-error`). JSON fields snake_case, enum values kebab-case.

- Nothing is shown as delivered until read back; `turn-ended` never fills a box. A turn ended on an API error shows like any turn end (STATUS `idle`, `wait` reads `turn-ended`, no distinct status, colour or hint); its only trace is one closed cause word of nine in `--json` and MCP `wait` event data, and the CLI's error text is shown nowhere.

- A refused send folds into its send line; `turn-ended` never fills a readback box; a turn the CLI ends on an API error shows like any turn end (STATUS `idle`, `wait` `turn-ended`, no distinct status, colour or hint; the only trace one closed cause word of nine in `--json` and MCP `wait` event data, the CLI's error text shown nowhere); a nonzero `skipped` count stays visible; a bare strip is never cocked nor a target.

| High (user content) | prompts, `last_assistant_message`, tool `input`, plans, dialog questions, options and option text (`option_details`: each option's description and preview), dialog answers, drift reports | Only in contract payloads (`events.ndjson`, `wait`/`last`, `hook.dialog`) and `instances/<name>/diagnostics/detail-*`; never in stderr, `--json` errors, MCP errors, channel `error.data`; a StopFailure's error text, `error_details` and `last_assistant_message` dropped at the parse, only one word of the closed nine-word turn-end cause set crossing |

- `Read::take(MAX_FRAME)` (16 MiB) before `read_line` / `read_to_end` on every external reader, and `viola mcp`'s stdin through `viola_mcp::stdin::CappedLines` at `MAX_FRAME` per line (an over-long line refused whole, ending the session), and the Claude transcript read without following a symlink, only as a regular file owned by the effective user, from the recorded pre-send offset through `MAX_FRAME`, yielding a count of local-command-stdout tags alone with no byte kept; serde_json default depth (never `unbounded_depth`; `deny.toml` bans the feature, its firing proven by `scripts/deny-probes.sh`). A SessionStart transcript path is accepted only when absolute, with no parent component, its file name exactly the payload's own session id plus `.jsonl` and that id of the closed session-id shape; the hook checks it and the wrapper re-checks it. In a hook payload each question's `option_details` keeps an option's `description` / `preview` only as strings (else `null`, never refusing the dialog), and the Stop's `background_tasks` is read as `IgnoredAny` elements and carried only as its length (`null` when absent, `null` or not an array); a StopFailure's error text, `error_details` and `last_assistant_message` are dropped at the parse, its turn-ended data holding only `null` `last_assistant_message` and `background_tasks` and one word of the closed nine-word turn-end cause set (crossing into `events.ndjson`, `wait --json` and MCP `wait`), and its error word is classified into one of those nine cause words inside the Claude adapter crate only, and only that cause word crosses out of the adapter, never the error word or any error text; the option text crossing into `events.ndjson`, `hook.dialog`, CLI `wait --json` and MCP `wait` is a boundary widening the founder answered himself (P4 fork Q4 of chunk 2026-10-19-overseer-switch-to-viola). The Claude transcript path is a redacted value, carried only as the optional `transcript` param beside `hook.event`, and appears in no event data, events log, log line, span, reply or verify record.

- **Path 3 — `wait` / `last`** — wakes only on driver-relevant kinds (activity and wheel records, and a harness-origin `prompt-submitted`, never wake a parked `wait`), returns already-logged events at once, typed timeout, exit 21 on a vanished wrapper (`detail` `endpoint-lost` for a wrapper killed under a parked `wait`, after `cleanup` `instance-dead` in a kept home or `unwrapped-name` in a removed one; MCP the same body less `v`, `mcp_tools_a_wrapper_killed_under_a_parked_wait_reads_endpoint_lost`); as landed, the cli + wrapper-channel half (`tests/cli_wait_last.rs`, `tests/chaos_wait_vanish.rs`) in CI on `ubuntu-latest`, the MCP `wait` / `last` steps landed at chunk 2026-10-17-mcp-server-for-drivers (`crates/viola-e2e/tests/mcp_tools.rs` `mcp_tools_path2_path3_send_wait_last_match_the_cli`, each result compared with the CLI's `--json` document less `v`); the end-to-end wake witness of all three dialog kinds landed with Path 4 (`question` / `plan` in `path4_dialogs_…`, `permission` in `path4_permission_…`, where a PostToolUse `activity` line wakes no `wait`); a Stop's `turn-ended` data carries `background_tasks`, the Stop array's length or `null`, and an API-error turn end's carries `cause` too, absent on a Stop and one of nine closed words (`rate-limited`, `overloaded`, `auth-failed`, `billing`, `invalid-request`, `model-not-found`, `server-error`, `output-limit`, `api-error`) (`tests/hook_events.rs` `hook_a_recorded_stop_carries_its_background_task_count` over the recorded 2.1.287 `Stop.default.json`, so 0, with `state_events_background_tasks_and_option_details_are_known_keys`; a non-zero and a `null` count unit-tier; live on 2.1.296 on the Linux dev host, a local measurement and no suite, a product `wait --json` woke on `turn-ended` with `background_tasks` 0 and `last` read the turn)

- Log only fields named in obs-plan §6 (default-deny, enforced by G4). `detail` codes are closed kebab-case lists — never a path or pid. `schemas/diag-line.v1.json` closes `process-exit`'s at 19 values; exit 21's closed causes are `instance-dead`, `unwrapped-name`, `endpoint-lost`, `strict-modes-failed`, `server-verify-failed`, `socket-dir-refused` (`during` `call` for `endpoint-lost` alone; `instance-dead`, `unwrapped-name`, `server-verify-failed` and `socket-dir-refused` are `during` `connect`), and `stale-heartbeat` is exit 1's cause alone (a frame verb against a stale instance reads `instance-dead`). `channel-response` carries `detail` on a `-32602` only (`unsupported-version` · `invalid-params` · `release-from-driver`, from `ProtocolError::cause`, on the server's and the client's line alike, closed by `schemas/diag-line.v1.json`) and none on any other `channel-response` line, a refusal's included, whose own `detail` stays on `send-refused`. A hyprctl reply that is oversize or malformed gives one codes-only `parse-rejected{parser:"hyprctl-json"}` line, written by the Hyprland seam (never `unknown`). A StopFailure error word outside the CLI's 13 writes one WARN `parse-rejected{parser:"hook-stdin", detail:"unknown-value", count:1}` (code and count only) and the event is still delivered as a turn end with cause `api-error`; a known word writes no line.

verification.acceptance: For each of the 13 `error` words the CLI's StopFailure schema declares, a wrapper over the fake agent appends a `turn-ended` whose cause is that word's mapped word — `rate_limit` rate-limited · `overloaded` overloaded · `authentication_failed`, `oauth_org_not_allowed`, `account_on_hold`, `verification_required`, `cloud_credential_error` auth-failed · `billing_error` billing · `invalid_request` invalid-request · `model_not_found` model-not-found · `server_error` server-error · `max_output_tokens` output-limit · `unknown` api-error — and an outside string or an absent `error` reads `api-error` (`hook_stop_failure_names_the_cause_of_each_cli_error_word`); a parked `viola wait --json` reads the word (`path5_an_api_error_turn_end_clears_the_turn_with_no_pause_or_release`, server-error) and MCP `wait` carries it unchanged (`handlers_wait_carries_a_turn_end_cause_word_unchanged`, rate-limited); no event line, snapshot, role line or detail line under the home holds a planted `error_details`, `last_assistant_message` or outside `error` value (the file walks of `hook_stop_failure_error_text_reaches_no_event_line_or_snapshot` and the booted case above).
